risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Security Breaches
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in the risk factors section with strong language: 'disrupt our operations', 'compromise the confidentiality'. It is assessed as critical for the company and its reputation

risks.title: Customer Orders and Forecasts Dependency
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in the MD&A section. Cancellation or reduction of orders without notice can result in sales losses and inventory issues

risks.title: Loss of Key Design Wins
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes the importance of design wins for new products and future revenue. Loss of a key contract or production delay could significantly impact growth

risks.title: Fabless Model and Supplier Dependencies
risks.score_rationale: The fabless model is a structural advantage, but the text also mentions risks of supply constraints and cost increases if demand exceeds foundry capacity

risks.title: New Market Adoption Risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned as a key factor affecting performance, related to the evaluation of new market opportunities and new product launches in emerging applications

risks.title: Information Technology System Failures
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly mentioned in the risk factors section, related to IT system failures or network interruptions. It directly impacts operations

ai_positioning.summary: SiTime positions its precision timing solutions as critical for AI datacenter deployments. The company benefited from strong AI datacenter deployment growth in 2025, which drove 61% revenue growth
evidence: Revenue increased by $124.0 million, or 61%, for 2025 compared to 2024 primarily driven by demand for our products in AI and datacenter applications
In 2025, we benefitted from the strong growth in AI datacenter deployments

Our products have been designed into over 400 applications across our target markets, including artificial intelligence (AI) systems, datacenter, communications, enterprise, automotive, industrial, aerospace, defense, mobile, Internet of Things (IoT), and consumer
